description: From the upper gardens the long pale facade of La Granja stands above the formal parterre as a restrained moonlit silhouette, its central portico just catching the night light. Below, the geometric French gardens and the mythological fountains lie dark, with a few garden lamps glowing along the terraces. Behind the palace the Sierra de Guadarrama rises as a dark wall under the cloudy night sky, and the whole scene keeps the quiet of the Bourbon summer retreat after hours.
